name: Meeting Entitlement
definition: Notification of the entitlement that one party has in relation with a specific meeting.

EntitlementFixingDate.name: Entitlement Fixing Date
EntitlementFixingDate.definition: Date at which the positions are struck to note which parties will receive the entitlement, e.g. record date, book close date...

EntitlementRatio.name: Entitlement Ratio
EntitlementRatio.definition: Number of votes assigned to one security.

EntitlementCalculationDate.name: Entitlement Calculation Date
EntitlementCalculationDate.definition: Date at which the positions are calculated.

EligiblePosition.name: Eligible Position
EligiblePosition.definition: Amount of securities that are eligible for the vote.

RelatedServicing.name: Related Servicing
RelatedServicing.definition: Services which include the entitlement calculation.
